from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in points), min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar in range(h-sh+1):
        for ac in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[ar+r][ac+c] == 0 for r, c in shape):
                for r,c in shape: out[ar+r][ac+c] = color
    return out

def parse(s): return [[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in s.splitlines()]
